**What you want to happen**

**Why it would be worth having**

**What it would replace or sit beside**

The screen it belongs on, and the thing it would take the place of, if it has one.

**Anything you have seen elsewhere**

A link to an app that does this, or the behaviour of a system setting, is worth more than a
description of the idea. Screenshots help.

## A note on scope

The app is a storefront over catalogues that belong to other people. A feature that needs something
those sites do not publish is a feature that cannot be built, so it helps to say which catalogue
and which page the idea is about.
